title: Application Engineer
description:
Position Title: Application Engineer

Grade: L1

Reports To: Territory Sales Manager

Remuneration (Approx. CTC): ₹5\.0 LPA to ₹8\.0 LPA

Location: Coimbatore

Ideal Profile \& Requirements:

Educational Qualification: B.E. (Mechanical)

Total \& Relevant Experience: 2 to 5 years

Age Limit: 24 to 28 years

Functional \& Technical Expertise:

Pre\-sales, technical consultation, and engineering principles behind product applications.

Understanding product technical specifications and operational limitations.

Technical support, troubleshooting, and product demonstrations.

Purpose of the Role:

Deliver ambitious sales growth within assigned focus markets.

Drive business development and secure product specification and approval with key Institutions and OEMs.

Build a healthy project pipeline to propel long\-term commercial success.

Main Responsibilities \& Key Deliverables:

Technical Sales \& Pre\-Sales: Meet with prospective clients daily to assess technical needs, conduct product demonstrations, and recommend customized solutions.

Account \& Pipeline Management: Develop deep technical knowledge of product technologies (such as industrial adhesives) to build and maintain a strong sales pipeline.

Relationship Building: Establish and cultivate strong long\-term business relationships with key decision\-makers, influencers, and technical leads at large manufacturing facilities and OEMs.

Reporting \& Compliance: Ensure prompt and accurate submission of daily sales reports, respecting strict adherence to deadlines.

Key Stakeholder Interactions:

External (Customers): Daily client visits, technical solution presentations, product demonstrations, and continuous technical support.

Internal (Cross\-Functional Teams):

Reporting Manager: Regular communication on client interactions, sales progress, and pipeline updates.

Purchase Team: Collaborate on material requirements to align with project timelines.

Accounts Team: Coordinate on client billing, invoicing, and payment processing.

Management Team: Align on strategic sales targets and business initiatives.

Working Conditions:

Field Travel: Requires high mobility with up to 90% travel within the assigned territory for client meetings and technical demonstrations.

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹70,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Location:

* Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Component Sub System Manager 1
description:
Req ID: 529098

  



At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.  

Could you be the full\-time Components Subsystem Manager in Coimbatore we’re looking for?

  

**Your future role**



Take on a new challenge and apply your comprehensive project management expertise in a new cutting\-edge field. You’ll work alongside dedicated, collaborative, and innovative teammates.



You'll lead and execute the RS Electrical Wiring Harenss and cabinet sub\-system Project, ensuring QCD commitments are met in line with Project \& EDC \& Electrical requirements. Day\-to\-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (Industrial, Finance, Quality, Sourcing, Supply Chain), organize the project, build the project team, and much more.You’ll specifically take care of the detailed planning from Notice to Proceed to end of Warranty, ensure strong Change \& configuration management, and manage variation orders.



We’ll look to you for:


* Ensuring commercial success and customer satisfaction, considering all stakeholders.
* Leading the RS Electrical Harness and Cubicle project to meet QCD objectives
* Clear communication of deliverables and goals to internal \& external stakeholders
* Effective control of the budget and financial reporting
* Identification and management of risks and opportunities


Contributing to continuous improvement actions and knowledge sharing  

**All about you**


* We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role
* Graduate and Post Graduate in (Electrical/Mechanical) degree
* Experience or understanding of Project Management (15\+ yrs preferred)
* Knowledge of working with international teams
* Familiarity with the rail industry's standards and practices
* A PMP/IPMA certification (highly preferable)
* Proven leadership and team\-building skills
* Excellent communication and motivational skills  

**Things you’ll enjoy**
* Join us on a life\-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career.
* You’ll also:
* Enjoy stability, challenges and a long\-term career free from boring daily routines
* Work with cutting\-edge technology and new security standards for rail signalling
* Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
* Contribute to innovative projects that shape the future of mobility
* Utilise our flexible working environment
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award\-winning learning
* Progress towards leadership and specialized roles
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

  


You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

  


**Important to note**


As a global business, we’re an equal\-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

  


Job Type:Experienced  



  

**Job Segment:** Supply Chain Manager, Project Manager, Supply Chain, Supply, Manager, Operations, Technology, Management

title: Area Manager
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72\+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.


**A Day in the Life**
=====================

**Careers that Change Lives**

Medtronic Cardiac Surgery partners with cardiac surgeons, perfusionists, and operating room teams to deliver technologies that support complex cardiac and vascular procedures. The portfolio includes cardiac surgery solutions used across the surgical continuum, providing clinical and technical support to healthcare professionals while driving adoption of therapies that improve patient outcomes.  



**A Day in the Life**

This Area Manager role is responsible for commercial growth and customer engagement across Tamil Nadu, excluding Coimbatore. The position follows a remote work style with frequent field\-based customer interaction and approximately 50% travel across assigned accounts, hospitals, and healthcare institutions within the territory.  



The Area Manager is responsible for driving sales performance, expanding market presence, and supporting clinical adoption of Cardiac Surgery products across the assigned territory. This role works closely with cardiac surgeons, perfusion teams, hospital stakeholders, and procurement functions to deliver product education, procedural support, and account development strategies that contribute to business growth and customer success.  



  

  

**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**

* Drive territory sales growth by executing account plans and identifying opportunities to expand adoption of Cardiac Surgery therapies across assigned hospitals and healthcare institutions.
* Build and maintain clinical and commercial relationships with cardiac surgeons, perfusionists, operating room staff, vascular specialists, and procurement stakeholders.
* Provide product education, technical support, and clinical expertise to support safe and effective use of Cardiac Surgery technologies.
* Deliver procedural support during surgical cases, including troubleshooting and follow\-up activities to ensure customer satisfaction and therapy adoption.
* Conduct product training and in\-service programmes for new and existing customers on assigned therapy portfolios.
* Partner with key implant center's to develop strategies that increase product utilisation and support progression toward technical self\-sufficiency.
* Gather and communicate market intelligence, customer feedback, competitive activity, and product performance insights to internal stakeholders.
Maintain accurate sales forecasts, customer records, inventory\-related activities, and territory data within approved business systems.  
* 

  

  

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

* High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 8\+ years experience
* OR Associate’s Degree AND 6\+ years experience
OR Bachelor’s Degree AND 4\+ years experience  
* 

  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Cardiac Surgery, Cardiovascular, Structural Heart, Perfusion, Extracorporeal Life Support, or related medical device therapies.
* Degree or certification in Perfusion Technology.
* Master's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, or Master of Business Administration.
* Experience supporting live surgical procedures and working directly with cardiac surgeons and operating room teams.
Knowledge of hospital purchasing processes, account development strategies, and healthcare market dynamics within South India.  
* 

  

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

  

The physical demands described within the Responsibilities section of this job description are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co\-workers.  



  

**ABOUT MEDTRONIC:**

Together, we can change healthcare worldwide. At Medtronic, we push the limits of what technology can do to help alleviate pain, restore health and extend life. We challenge ourselves and each other to make tomorrow better than yesterday. It is what makes this an exciting and rewarding place to be.  



  

We can accelerate and advance our ability to create meaningful innovations – but we will only succeed with the right people on our team. Let’s work together to address universal healthcare needs and improve patients’ lives. Help us shape the future.  



**Physical Job Requirements**  

  

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.
‌
‌  



**Recruitment Fraud Alert**

We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:  



  

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.  



  

Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.  



  

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments.  



  

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic.com .


**Benefits \& Compensation**
============================

**Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package**  

A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.

title: Implementation Architect
description:
**Implementation Architect**


**Location: Bengaluru/Coimbatore**


**About AppViewX:**



AppViewX is the only machine and agent identity security company built for the AI and quantum era, bringing together discovery, automation, control, and intelligence. The AVX Platform helps enterprises reduce risk by providing complete visibility and governance over every machine and AI agent identity, automating their lifecycle, controlling their access, and proving compliance at the speed business demands. Trusted by global enterprises across financial services, healthcare, and technology, AppViewX is recognized as a leader in the IDC 2026 MarketScape for Certificate Lifecycle Management and KuppingerCole's 2025 Non\-Human Identity Management Leadership Compass. For more information, users can visit appviewx.com.


**Our Values**



Our values define how we work, make decisions, and deliver for our customers and each other. Some reflect strengths deeply engrained in how we work. Others represent the standards we are committed to building together.


* **We Do What We Say:** We own our commitments, communicate honestly about progress, and measure success by results, not activity.
* **We Are Trusted Experts:** We continuously build our expertise, offer candid guidance, and focus on the outcomes our customers and colleagues need.
* **We Raise the Bar:** We stay curious, challenge the status quo, take smart risks, and turn better ideas into meaningful results.
* **We Win Together:** We share information, debate openly, commit together, and recognize that our success is connected to the success of our customers and teammates.


If these values reflect how you want to work and contribute, you will find an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at AppViewX.


**What will you be responsible for?**



Customer Success Implementation Architects play a key role in driving Customer onboarding, Solutioning and ongoing adoption and usage of AppViewX product. You will lead the implementation of AppViewX solutions for automating customer IT Network infrastructure and Public Key Infrastructure. You will combine your deep technical knowledge with an understanding of customer business objectives /challenges help customers maximize the value of AppViewX products. You will work in the Customer Success team looking at opportunities to automate service offerings around different AppViewX products, tools and processes.


**Onboarding**


* Working with our Customer Success Managers and Customer Success Design Architects, implement AppViewX technology to solve specific business challenges for our new customers
* Address customer objectives/success criteria with in\-depth technical attention to help customer Go\-live quickly.


**Adoption and Value Quantification**


* Working with our Customer Success Managers and Customer Success Design Architects, implement additional AppViewX technology to solve specific business challenges for our new customers
* Act as a trusted technical advisor by assisting customers navigate technical challenges throughout the implementation process.
* Identify new use cases as part of account growth/renewal strategy


**Customer Experience/Engagement**


* Use your experiences working with customers to provide feedback to the rest of the AppViewX organization on how we can improve the customer experience, speed time\-to\-value, and create greater benefits for our customers
* Use your experience to look at opportunities to automate, develop tools that aid your team to reduce man hours.
* Contribute to Customer Business Reviews highlighting potential areas of improvements.


 **Roadmap Planning**


* Partner closely with other cross\-functional team members (e.g., sales, product management, support, services, delivery) to translate business needs and product requirements into new solutions
* Work closely with our Product and Engineering teams to prioritize product enhancements and long term roadmap based on customer/industry priorities.


**What do we require?**


* Minimum 5 years' experience working in a technical implementation role
* Open to work in US Shift
* Minimum 3 years' experience working in customer\-facing technical roles (such as Customer Success Engineer, Solution Engineer, Professional Services Engineer, Technical Support Engineer, Subject Matter Expert), preferably in a post\-sales capacity, for a SaaS company with enterprise software products
* Love of programming, solid coding skills in one or more of the following languages: Python, JavaScript, Java.
* Experience with web service development and using RESTful APIs
* Understanding of configuration management tools such as Chef/Puppet/Vagrant/Ansible/Salt preferred
* Experience with building Jenkins/automated test frameworks preferred
* Domain knowledge on **PKI**, DNS, Active Directory,cloud, ADCS, CRL, OCSP, and associated cryptographic standards
* + Experience with Certificate Life Cycle management/operations
	+ Experience with PKI implementation processes
	+ Experience with PKI integrations, MS Intune, SCEP, other enrollment practices
* Hands on experience with:
* + Kubernetes
	+ Linux / Windows server management
	+ Apache, IIS \- application expertise
* CISSP / CISM / CISA is preferred
* Excellent organization, troubleshooting, problem solving, deployment and multitasking skills with ability to learn new technology at a fast pace
* Worked and interacted with F500 organizations
* Exceptional communication skills, both oral and written, coupled with excellent listening skills


**Why AppViewX?**



AppViewX caters to a wide range of customers from Fortune 1000 companies, including six of the top ten global commercial banks, five of the top ten global media companies, and five of the top ten managed healthcare providers. Over the years, we grew our diverse team, perfected our automation platform, and expanded our global footprint to India, North America, United Kingdom, and Australia. Today, we are headquartered in New York City and have come a long way by optimizing opportunities to create lasting relationships with enterprises, gaining unshakable customer trust along the way.



AppViewX is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. It is AppViewX's policy to afford equal employment opportunities to all employees regardless of race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, citizenship status, gender, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military or veteran status, pregnancy, disability, genetic information, arrest record, or other protected class under state, federal, or local law.

title: Customer Success Executive
description:
Customer Success Executive

**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu  
**Experience:** 1–2 Years  
**Industry:** EdTech / Education / Training  
**Job Type:** Full\-time \| On\-site

Job Summary

We are looking for a proactive **Customer Success Executive** with 1–2 years of experience in customer\-facing roles, preferably in the EdTech, Education, or Training industry. The ideal candidate will engage with prospective learners, guide them in selecting suitable courses, and drive enrollments through effective communication and relationship management.

Key Responsibilities

* Contact and engage prospective students through outbound calls.
* Understand learner requirements and recommend suitable courses.
* Convert leads into enrollments through effective follow\-up and counseling.
* Explain course offerings, fees, training schedules, and placement support.
* Handle customer queries and maintain strong customer relationships.
* Update lead information and track follow\-up activities.
* Meet individual and team enrollment targets.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure a seamless customer experience.

Requirements

* 1–2 years of experience in Customer Success, Inside Sales, Telecalling, or Business Development.
* Prior experience in EdTech, Education, or Training is preferred.
* Strong communication, persuasion, and relationship\-building skills.
* Comfortable with outbound calling and lead follow\-ups.
* Target\-oriented, proactive, and customer\-focused.
* Familiarity with online learning platforms is an added advantage.

Share profile to Akshayaa.k@expertspro.io

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
